scope: Construction of one explicitly selected 5000 m3/day potable-water treatment plant WTP-RGF-5000-4F with coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation, four rapid-gravity filters and chlorination; four raw-water pumps, four treated-water pumps and 80 t anthracite filter media. Direct process equipment, media, civil works, piping, electrical-controls, labor, mechanisms, testing and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved potable-water treatment process design, hydraulic profile, civil drawings, equipment-piping-instrument schedules, filter-media specification, electrical-control design, geotechnical report, commissioning program, suppliers and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: concrete, reinforcement, equipment, piping, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from plant capacity
unconditional generic one-set pumps or aeration equipment
automatic excavation shoring, groundwater dewatering or road reinstatement
universal retained spare or supplier-package mass
water intake, distribution network, reservoir, tower, wastewater treatment or invented price
